provenance.tool: hand computation and property test (Python standard library)
provenance.steps: Generated fixture: tests/reference/pipeline.py generate_book from OOS-FREEZE-01/book.json, a deterministic process with no random draw. Three groups (MTG_FIX EUR, MTG_FIX USD, CON_FIX EUR) of 140 active bullet loans of one balance each (1,000, 2,000 and 400); at each month end the oldest active loans prepay in full, 3, 4 and 5 per month up to 2022-12-31 and 6, 7 and 8 per month after it, and as many new loans originate in that month, so each month's pool SMM is exactly k / 140. Data window 2019-12-31 to 2024-12-31; estimation window 2019-12-31 to 2022-12-31, 36 month ends with loan-months, 140 x 36 = 5,040 loan-months and 108, 144 and 180 FULL events, above the minimum sample of M9; test window 2023-01-31 to 2023-12-31, 12 origins whose 12-month horizons end by 2024-12-31 (V1). The generated files are an accepted import (data_reader.read_import: no error, no warning). PM0 is the realised CPR of the estimation window, 1 - (1 - k/140)^12 for a constant monthly SMM of k/140, derived exactly in rationals. Hand instance: the forecasts from all 12 origins of each group carry one parameter set, whose CPR is that value and whose diagnostics give the month ends, loan-months and FULL events counted above. Property: each trial applies one to three random valid changes anywhere in the data (any group, panel, register or market rates, any date) and requires every origin of a group to carry the same parameter set, equal in its estimate to the one fitted on the data truncated at the end of the estimation window. Negative control: re-estimating at an origin on the view at that origin gives other parameters, because the SMM is 6/140 rather than 3/140 after 2022-12-31.

tolerance: exact; abs 1e-12 for the CPR against its rational value
